Deprecation should be interpreted as a fair warning that the version will soon be turned off. Developers will actively be encouraged to upgrade their code at that point. Sunset means that the version is no longer available.

To be notified about upcoming sunsets, join the Google Ad Manager API Sunset Announcements group and adjust your notification settings. Additionally, you can receive alerts if calls are being made to your network with a deprecated API version by enabling the "Deprecated API in use" notification type in the Ad Manager UI.

The current schedule is deprecation / sunset takes effect on the last weekday of:

API version Deprecation Sunset
v202608 May 2027 August 2027
v202605 February 2027 May 2027
v202602 November 2026 February 2027
v202511 August 2026 November 2026
v202508 May 2026 August 2026
v202505 February 2026 May 2026
